name: SkeletonForm

props.description: Columns of the form this stands in for. Passed straight to ResponsiveGrid, so it is the SAME value and the SAME breakpoint ladder the Form uses — that shared source is the point of the component.
props.name: columns

props.description: How many label+control pairs to draw.
props.name: fields

props.description: Travelling sheen instead of the pulse.
props.name: active

related: Form — the thing this stands in for; give both the same `columns`.
FormField — the label+control pair each cell here draws.
SkeletonRows — a FLAT list of lines, for a list. Not a form.
SkeletonInput — one field's control on its own, when you are composing something else.
tagline: The skeleton of a `Form columns={N}` — label + control PAIRS on the form's own ResponsiveGrid, not the flat line list SkeletonRows draws.
usage: DO pass the same `columns` the Form takes. Anything else and the layout jumps when the data lands.
DO use it instead of SkeletonRows for a form: a field is a short label stacked on a full-width control, and SkeletonRows has no idea a cell has an inside.
DON'T hand-assemble SkeletonInput inside a ResponsiveGrid to approximate one — that is what this replaces, and 'close enough' drifts the first time someone changes the Form's columns.
useCases: An edit form before the record resolves
A multi-column settings panel on first paint
A wizard step whose defaults arrive from the server
